name: superheroes

autoCheckpointTokens.title: Auto-checkpoint threshold (tokens)
autoCheckpointTokens.description: Context size at which the session saves its checkpoint notes and compacts itself.

autoCheckpointAllowance.title: Auto-checkpoint allowance (tokens)
autoCheckpointAllowance.description: How many tokens before the harness's own auto-compaction the checkpoint must land.

autoCheckpointMode.title: Auto-checkpoint mode
autoCheckpointMode.description: auto: checkpoint and compact on its own; click-only: only when you press Now on the band; off: never.

description: The discipline layer around AI build sessions: Showrunner (advisor), Workhorse (builder), Detective (observe-only diagnosis), The Architect (spec), Review Crew (cross-vendor review), Test-Pilot (browser evidence), Guardian (repo-health sweeps) — one plugin.
